feedback: Strong Swiss/International visual system with correct black/red/cream palette, persistent desktop sidebar, responsive hamburger drawer, visible grid/baseline guides, German labels, and all specified pages/assets present. Most page structures match the specification well, especially the homepage, collection, object detail, essay index/detail, and contact layouts. Deductions: the raster-system page is documentation but not meaningfully interactive; the collection grid shows only a small sample rather than the dense 1-48 result implied; the about page mission is not a single 800px text column and the timeline is only partially visible in mobile/tablet captures; some tablet/mobile layouts stack or reposition elements more generically than the spec's precise responsive ratios. Overall it is polished, consistent, and close to spec, but not a perfect complex implementation.
